verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם מִקְרָאֵ֣י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מוֹעֲדָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem mō·w·‘ă·ḏê Yah·weh ’ă·šer- tiq·rə·’ū ’ō·ṯām miq·rā·’ê qō·ḏeš ’êl·leh hêm mō·w·‘ă·ḏāy
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and say to them These are My appointed feasts the feasts of the LORD that you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: As solenidades do SENHOR, que convocareis, serão santas convocações; estas são as minhas solenidades:

verses.original: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ תֵּעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י שַׁבַּ֤ת שַׁבָּתוֹן֙ מִקְרָא־ קֹ֔דֶשׁ כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ שַׁבָּ֥ת הִוא֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל מֽוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm tê·‘ā·śeh mə·lā·ḵāh ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î šab·baṯ šab·bā·ṯō·wn miq·rā- qō·ḏeš kāl- mə·lā·ḵāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū šab·bāṯ hî Yah·weh bə·ḵōl mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: For six days work may be done but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest a day of sacred assembly You must not do any work wherever you live it is a Sabbath to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Seis dias trabalho se fará, mas o sétimo dia será o sábado do descanso, santa convocação; nenhum trabalho fareis; sábado do SENHOR é em todas as vossas habitações.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִקְרָאֵ֖י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם בְּמוֹעֲדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh mō·w·‘ă·ḏê Yah·weh miq·rā·’ê qō·ḏeš ’ă·šer- tiq·rə·’ū ’ō·ṯām bə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏām
verses.literal: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times
verses.literalPt: Estas são as solenidades do SENHOR, as santas convocações, que convocareis ao seu tempo determinado:

verses.original: בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ בֵּ֣ין הָעַרְבָּ֑יִם פֶּ֖סַח לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār la·ḥō·ḏeš bên hā·‘ar·bā·yim pe·saḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The Passover to the LORD begins at twilight on the fourteenth . . . day of the first month
verses.literalPt: No mês primeiro, aos catorze do mês, pela tarde, é a páscoa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֔ה חַ֥ג הַמַּצּ֖וֹת לַיהוָ֑ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים מַצּ֥וֹת תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇa·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš haz·zeh ḥaḡ ham·maṣ·ṣō·wṯ Yah·weh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm maṣ·ṣō·wṯ tō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: On the fifteenth . . . day of the same month begins the Feast of Unleavened Bread to the LORD For seven days you must eat unleavened bread
verses.literalPt: E aos quinze dias deste mês é a festa dos pães ázimos do SENHOR; sete dias comereis pães ázimos.

verses.original: בַּיּוֹם֙ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן מִקְרָא־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm hā·ri·šō·wn miq·rā- qō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: On the first day you are to hold a sacred assembly you are not to do any regular work
verses.literalPt: No primeiro dia tereis santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis;

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֛ה לַיהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ מִקְרָא־ קֹ֔דֶשׁ כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ’iš·šeh Yah·weh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î miq·rā- qō·ḏeš kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: For seven days you are to present a food offering to the LORD On the seventh day there shall be a sacred assembly you must not do any regular work
verses.literalPt: Mas sete dias oferecereis oferta queimada ao SENHOR; ao sétimo dia haverá santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם וּקְצַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ קְצִירָ֑הּ וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֶת־ עֹ֛מֶר רֵאשִׁ֥ית קְצִירְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kî- ṯā·ḇō·’ū ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’ă·nî nō·ṯên lā·ḵem ū·qə·ṣar·tem ’eṯ- qə·ṣî·rāh wa·hă·ḇê·ṯem ’eṯ- ‘ō·mer rê·šîṯ qə·ṣî·rə·ḵem ’el- hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and say When you enter . . . . . . the land that I am giving you and you reap its harvest you are to bring to the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes entrado na terra, que vos hei de dar, e fizerdes a sua colheita, então trareis um molho das primícias da vossa sega ao sacerdote;

verses.original: וְהֵנִ֧יף אֶת־ הָעֹ֛מֶר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֑ם מִֽמָּחֳרַת֙ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת יְנִיפֶ֖נּוּ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·nîp̄ ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·mer lip̄·nê Yah·weh lir·ṣō·nə·ḵem mim·mā·ḥo·raṯ haš·šab·bāṯ yə·nî·p̄en·nū hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD so that it may be accepted on your behalf the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath
verses.literalPt: E ele moverá o molho perante o SENHOR, para que sejais aceitos; no dia seguinte ao sábado o sacerdote o moverá.

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֕ם בְּי֥וֹם הֲנִֽיפְכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הָעֹ֑מֶר כֶּ֣בֶשׂ תָּמִ֧ים בֶּן־ שְׁנָת֛וֹ לְעֹלָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem bə·yō·wm hă·nî·p̄ə·ḵem ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·mer ke·ḇeś tā·mîm ben- šə·nā·ṯōw lə·‘ō·lāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: On the day you wave the sheaf you shall offer a year-old . . . lamb without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: E no dia em que moverdes o molho, preparareis um cordeiro sem defeito, de um ano, em holocausto ao SENHOR,

verses.original: וּמִנְחָתוֹ֩ שְׁנֵ֨י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים סֹ֣לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֛מֶן אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהוָ֖ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֑חַ וְנִסְכֹּ֥ה יַ֖יִן רְבִיעִ֥ת הַהִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min·ḥā·ṯōw šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm sō·leṯ bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·še·men ’iš·šeh Yah·weh rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ wə·nis·kōh ya·yin rə·ḇî·‘iṯ ha·hîn
verses.literal: along with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah . . . of fine flour mixed with oil a food offering to the LORD a pleasing aroma and its drink offering of a quarter hin of wine
verses.literalPt: E a sua oferta de alimentos, será de duas dízimas de flor de farinha, amassada com azeite, para oferta queimada em cheiro suave ao SENHOR, e a sua libação será de vinho, um quarto de him.

verses.original: וְלֶחֶם֩ וְקָלִ֨י וְכַרְמֶ֜ל לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֗וּ עַד־ עֶ֙צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה עַ֚ד הֲבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם אֶת־ קָרְבַּ֖ן אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·le·ḥem wə·qā·lî wə·ḵar·mel lō ṯō·ḵə·lū ‘aḏ- ‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh ‘aḏ hă·ḇî·’ă·ḵem ’eṯ- qā·rə·ban ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵōl mō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: You must not eat any bread or roasted or new grain until the very day you have brought this offering to your God This is to be a permanent statute for the generations to come wherever you live
verses.literalPt: E não comereis pão, nem trigo tostado, nem espigas verdes, até aquele mesmo dia em que trouxerdes a oferta do vosso Deus; estatuto perpétuo é por vossas gerações, em todas as vossas habitações.

verses.original: וּסְפַרְתֶּ֤ם לָכֶם֙ מִמָּחֳרַ֣ת הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת מִיּוֹם֙ הֲבִ֣יאֲכֶ֔ם אֶת־ עֹ֖מֶר הַתְּנוּפָ֑ה שֶׁ֥בַע שַׁבָּת֖וֹת תְּמִימֹ֥ת תִּהְיֶֽינָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·sə·p̄ar·tem lā·ḵem mim·mā·ḥo·raṯ haš·šab·bāṯ mî·yō·wm hă·ḇî·’ă·ḵem ’eṯ- ‘ō·mer hat·tə·nū·p̄āh še·ḇa‘ šab·bā·ṯō·wṯ tə·mî·mōṯ tih·ye·nāh
verses.literal: From the day after the Sabbath the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering you are to count off seven full weeks
verses.literalPt: Depois para vós contareis desde o dia seguinte ao sábado, desde o dia em que trouxerdes o molho da oferta movida; sete semanas inteiras serão.

verses.original: עַ֣ד מִֽמָּחֳרַ֤ת הַשַּׁבָּת֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔ת תִּסְפְּר֖וּ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים י֑וֹם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֛ם מִנְחָ֥ה חֲדָשָׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ mim·mā·ḥo·raṯ haš·šab·bāṯ haš·šə·ḇî·‘iṯ tis·pə·rū ḥă·miš·šîm yō·wm wə·hiq·raḇ·tem min·ḥāh ḥă·ḏā·šāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: You shall count off fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath and then present an offering of new grain to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Até ao dia seguinte ao sétimo sábado, contareis cinqüenta dias; então oferecereis nova oferta de alimentos ao SENHOR.

verses.original: מִמּוֹשְׁבֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם תָּבִ֣יאּוּ׀ לֶ֣חֶם תְּנוּפָ֗ה שְׁ֚תַּיִם שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים סֹ֣לֶת תִּהְיֶ֔ינָה חָמֵ֖ץ תֵּאָפֶ֑ינָה בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mim·mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem tā·ḇî’·’ū le·ḥem tə·nū·p̄āh šə·ta·yim šə·nê ‘eś·rō·nîm sō·leṯ tih·ye·nāh ḥā·mêṣ tê·’ā·p̄e·nāh bik·kū·rîm Yah·weh
verses.literal: Bring two loaves of bread from your dwellings as a wave offering each made from two-tenths of an ephah . . . of fine flour . . . baked with leaven as the firstfruits to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Das vossas habitações trareis dois pães de movimento; de duas dízimas de farinha serão, levedados se cozerão; primícias são ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֣ם עַל־ הַלֶּ֗חֶם שִׁבְעַ֨ת כְּבָשִׂ֤ים תְּמִימִם֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה וּפַ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד וְאֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם יִהְי֤וּ עֹלָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָתָם֙ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֔ם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ‘al- hal·le·ḥem šiḇ·‘aṯ kə·ḇā·śîm tə·mî·mim bə·nê šā·nāh ū·p̄ar ben- bā·qār ’e·ḥāḏ wə·’ê·lim šə·nā·yim yih·yū ‘ō·lāh Yah·weh ū·min·ḥā·ṯām wə·nis·kê·hem ’iš·šêh rê·aḥ- nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Along with the bread you are to present seven unblemished male lambs a year old . . . one young bull . . . . . . and two rams They will be a burnt offering to the LORD together with their grain offerings and drink offerings a food offering a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Também com o pão oferecereis sete cordeiros sem defeito, de um ano, e um novilho, e dois carneiros; holocausto serão ao SENHOR, com a sua oferta de alimentos, e as suas libações, por oferta queimada de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֛ם שְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּ֑את וּשְׁנֵ֧י כְבָשִׂ֛ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָ֖ה לְזֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem śə·‘îr- ‘iz·zîm ’e·ḥāḏ lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ū·šə·nê ḵə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê šā·nāh lə·ze·ḇaḥ šə·lā·mîm
verses.literal: You shall also prepare one male goat . . . as a sin offering and two male lambs a year old . . . as a peace offering . . .
verses.literalPt: Também oferecereis um bode para expiação do pecado, e dois cordeiros de um ano por sacrifício pacífico.

verses.original: וְהֵנִ֣יף הַכֹּהֵ֣ן׀ אֹתָ֡ם עַל֩ לֶ֨חֶם הַבִּכּוּרִ֤ים תְּנוּפָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י כְּבָשִׂ֑ים קֹ֛דֶשׁ יִהְי֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·nîp̄ hak·kō·hên ’ō·ṯām ‘al le·ḥem hab·bik·kū·rîm tə·nū·p̄āh lip̄·nê Yah·weh ‘al- šə·nê kə·ḇā·śîm qō·ḏeš yih·yū Yah·weh lak·kō·hên
verses.literal: The priest is to wave the lambs as a wave offering before the LORD together with the bread of the firstfruits The bread and the two lambs shall be holy to the LORD for the priest
verses.literalPt: Então o sacerdote os moverá com o pão das primícias por oferta movida perante o SENHOR, com os dois cordeiros; santos serão ao SENHOR para uso do sacerdote.

verses.original: וּקְרָאתֶ֞ם בְּעֶ֣צֶם׀ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם בְּכָל־ מוֹשְׁבֹ֥תֵיכֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·qə·rā·ṯem bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh miq·rā- qō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām bə·ḵāl mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: On that same day you are to proclaim . . . a sacred assembly and you must not do any regular work . . . This is to be a permanent statute wherever you live for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: E naquele mesmo dia apregoareis que tereis santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis; estatuto perpétuo é em todas as vossas habitações pelas vossas gerações.

verses.original: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶ֞ם אֶת־ קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֗ם לֹֽא־ תְכַלֶּ֞ה פְּאַ֤ת שָֽׂדְךָ֙ בְּקֻצְרֶ֔ךָ וְלֶ֥קֶט קְצִירְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽעָנִ֤י וְלַגֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·quṣ·rə·ḵem ’eṯ- qə·ṣîr ’ar·ṣə·ḵem lō- ṯə·ḵal·leh pə·’aṯ śā·ḏə·ḵā bə·quṣ·re·ḵā wə·le·qeṭ qə·ṣî·rə·ḵā lō ṯə·laq·qêṭ le·‘ā·nî wə·lag·gêr ta·‘ă·zōḇ ’ō·ṯām ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: When you reap the harvest of your land do not reap all the way to the edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest . . . Leave them for the poor and the foreign resident I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: E, quando fizerdes a colheita da vossa terra, não acabarás de segar os cantos do teu campo, nem colherás as espigas caídas da tua sega; para o pobre e para o estrangeiro as deixarás. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: The LORD also said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ שַׁבָּת֔וֹן זִכְר֥וֹן תְּרוּעָ֖ה מִקְרָא־ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem šab·bā·ṯō·wn ziḵ·rō·wn tə·rū·‘āh miq·rā- qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and say On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of rest a sacred assembly announced by trumpet blasts
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: No mês sétimo, ao primeiro do mês, tereis descanso, memorial com sonido de trombetas, santa convocação.

verses.original: כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must not do any regular work . . . but you are to present a food offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Nenhum trabalho servil fareis, mas oferecereis oferta queimada ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: אַ֡ךְ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ֩ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֨י הַזֶּ֜ה י֧וֹם הַכִּפֻּרִ֣ים ה֗וּא מִֽקְרָא־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ be·‘ā·śō·wr la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î haz·zeh yō·wm hak·kip·pu·rîm hū miq·rā- qō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem wə·‘in·nî·ṯem ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ’iš·šeh Yah·weh
verses.literal: The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement . . . You shall hold a sacred assembly and humble yourselves and present a food offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Mas aos dez dias desse sétimo mês será o dia da expiação; tereis santa convocação, e afligireis as vossas almas; e oferecereis oferta queimada ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וְכָל־ מְלָאכָה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י י֤וֹם כִּפֻּרִים֙ ה֔וּא לְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl mə·lā·ḵāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh kî yō·wm kip·pu·rîm hū lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ă·lê·ḵem lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: On this . . . day you are not to do any work for it is the Day of Atonement when atonement is made for you before the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: E naquele mesmo dia nenhum trabalho fareis, porque é o dia da expiação, para fazer expiação por vós perante o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל־ הַנֶּ֙פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ תְעֻנֶּ֔ה בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְנִכְרְתָ֖ה מֵֽעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵāl han·ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer lō- ṯə·‘un·neh bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh mê·‘am·me·hā
verses.literal: If anyone . . . does not humble himself on this . . . day he must be cut off from his people
verses.literalPt: Porque toda a alma, que naquele mesmo dia se não afligir, será extirpada do seu povo.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַנֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֔ה בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְהַֽאֲבַדְתִּ֛י אֶת־ הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl han·ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śeh kāl- mə·lā·ḵāh bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tî ’eṯ- han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·māh
verses.literal: I will destroy - . . . from among his people anyone . . . who does any work on this . . . day
verses.literalPt: Também toda a alma, que naquele mesmo dia fizer algum trabalho, eu a destruirei do meio do seu povo.

verses.original: כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מֹֽשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mə·lā·ḵāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ḵōl mō·šə·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: You are not to do any work at all This is a permanent statute for the generations to come wherever you live
verses.literalPt: Nenhum trabalho fareis; estatuto perpétuo é pelas vossas gerações em todas as vossas habitações.

verses.original: שַׁבַּ֨ת שַׁבָּת֥וֹן הוּא֙ לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּתִשְׁעָ֤ה לַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בָּעֶ֔רֶב מֵעֶ֣רֶב עַד־ עֶ֔רֶב תִּשְׁבְּת֖וּ שַׁבַּתְּכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: šab·baṯ šab·bā·ṯō·wn hū lā·ḵem wə·‘in·nî·ṯem ’eṯ- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem bə·ṯiš·‘āh la·ḥō·ḏeš bā·‘e·reḇ mê·‘e·reḇ ‘aḏ- ‘e·reḇ tiš·bə·ṯū šab·bat·tə·ḵem
verses.literal: It will be a Sabbath of complete rest for you and you shall humble yourselves From the evening of the ninth day of the month until . . . the following evening you are to keep your Sabbath
verses.literalPt: Sábado de descanso vos será; então afligireis as vossas almas; aos nove do mês à tarde, de uma tarde a outra tarde, celebrareis o vosso sábado.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֜ר י֗וֹם לַחֹ֤דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ הַזֶּ֔ה חַ֧ג הַסֻּכּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î haz·zeh ḥaḡ has·suk·kō·wṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm Yah·weh
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and say On the fifteenth . . . day of the seventh month the Feast of Tabernacles to the LORD begins and it continues for seven days
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Aos quinze dias deste mês sétimo será a festa dos tabernáculos ao SENHOR por sete dias.

verses.original: בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן מִקְרָא־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm hā·ri·šō·wn miq·rā- qō·ḏeš kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: On the first day there shall be a sacred assembly You must not do any regular work . . .
verses.literalPt: Ao primeiro dia haverá santa convocação; nenhum trabalho servil fareis.

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֡י מִקְרָא־ קֹדֶשׁ֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ עֲצֶ֣רֶת הִ֔וא כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm taq·rî·ḇū ’iš·šeh Yah·weh bay·yō·wm haš·šə·mî·nî miq·rā- qō·ḏeš yih·yeh lā·ḵem wə·hiq·raḇ·tem ’iš·šeh Yah·weh ‘ă·ṣe·reṯ hî kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: For seven days you are to present a food offering to the LORD On the eighth day you are to hold a sacred assembly and present a food offering to the LORD It is a solemn assembly you must not do any regular work . . .
verses.literalPt: Sete dias oferecereis ofertas queimadas ao SENHOR; ao oitavo dia tereis santa convocação, e oferecereis ofertas queimadas ao SENHOR; dia de proibição é, nenhum trabalho servil fareis.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם מִקְרָאֵ֣י קֹ֑דֶשׁ לְהַקְרִ֨יב אִשֶּׁ֜ה לַיהוָ֗ה עֹלָ֧ה וּמִנְחָ֛ה זֶ֥בַח וּנְסָכִ֖ים דְּבַר־ י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh mō·w·‘ă·ḏê Yah·weh ’ă·šer- tiq·rə·’ū ’ō·ṯām miq·rā·’ê qō·ḏeš lə·haq·rîḇ ’iš·šeh Yah·weh ‘ō·lāh ū·min·ḥāh ze·ḇaḥ ū·nə·sā·ḵîm də·ḇar- yō·wm bə·yō·w·mōw
verses.literal: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies for presenting food offerings to the LORD burnt offerings and grain offerings sacrifices and drink offerings each on its designated day
verses.literalPt: Estas são as solenidades do SENHOR, que apregoareis para santas convocações, para oferecer ao SENHOR oferta queimada, holocausto e oferta de alimentos, sacrifício e libações, cada qual em seu dia próprio;

verses.original: מִלְּבַ֖ד שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת יְּהוָ֑ה וּמִלְּבַ֣ד מַתְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וּמִלְּבַ֤ד כָּל־ נִדְרֵיכֶם֙ וּמִלְּבַד֙ כָּל־ נִדְב֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mil·lə·ḇaḏ šab·bə·ṯōṯ Yah·weh ū·mil·lə·ḇaḏ mat·tə·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem ū·mil·lə·ḇaḏ kāl- niḏ·rê·ḵem ū·mil·lə·ḇaḏ kāl- niḏ·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ’ă·šer tit·tə·nū Yah·weh
verses.literal: These offerings are in addition to the offerings for the LORD’s . . . Sabbaths and in addition to your gifts . . . to all your vow offerings . . . and to all the freewill offerings you give to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Além dos sábados do SENHOR, e além dos vossos dons, e além de todos os vossos votos, e além de todas as vossas ofertas voluntárias, que dareis ao SENHOR.

verses.original: אַ֡ךְ בַּחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י בְּאָסְפְּכֶם֙ אֶת־ תְּבוּאַ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ תָּחֹ֥גּוּ אֶת־ חַג־ יְהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּיּ֤וֹם הָֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ שַׁבָּת֔וֹן וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֖י שַׁבָּתֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î bə·’ā·sə·pə·ḵem ’eṯ- tə·ḇū·’aṯ hā·’ā·reṣ tā·ḥōg·gū ’eṯ- ḥaḡ- Yah·weh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm bay·yō·wm hā·ri·šō·wn šab·bā·ṯō·wn ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·mî·nî šab·bā·ṯō·wn
verses.literal: On the fifteenth . . . day of the seventh month after you have gathered the produce of the land you are to celebrate a feast to the LORD for seven days There shall be complete rest on the first day and also on the eighth day
verses.literalPt: Porém aos quinze dias do mês sétimo, quando tiverdes recolhido do fruto da terra, celebrareis a festa do SENHOR por sete dias; no primeiro dia haverá descanso, e no oitavo dia haverá descanso.

verses.original: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֨ם לָכֶ֜ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן פְּרִ֨י עֵ֤ץ הָדָר֙ כַּפֹּ֣ת תְּמָרִ֔ים וַעֲנַ֥ף עֵץ־ עָבֹ֖ת וְעַרְבֵי־ נָ֑חַל וּשְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·qaḥ·tem lā·ḵem bay·yō·wm hā·ri·šō·wn pə·rî ‘êṣ hā·ḏār kap·pōṯ tə·mā·rîm wa·‘ă·nap̄ ‘êṣ- ‘ā·ḇōṯ wə·‘ar·ḇê- nā·ḥal ū·śə·maḥ·tem lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: On the first day you are to gather the fruit of majestic trees the branches of palm trees and the boughs of leafy trees and of willows of the brook And you are to rejoice before the LORD your God for seven days
verses.literalPt: E no primeiro dia tomareis para vós ramos de formosas árvores, ramos de palmeiras, ramos de árvores frondosas, e salgueiros de ribeiras; e vos alegrareis perante o SENHOR vosso Deus por sete dias.

verses.original: וְחַגֹּתֶ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ חַ֣ג לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י תָּחֹ֥גּוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥag·gō·ṯem ’ō·ṯōw ḥaḡ Yah·weh šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm baš·šā·nāh ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î tā·ḥōg·gū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: You are to celebrate this as a feast to the LORD for seven days each year This is a permanent statute for the generations to come you are to celebrate it in the seventh month
verses.literalPt: E celebrareis esta festa ao SENHOR por sete dias cada ano; estatuto perpétuo é pelas vossas gerações; no mês sétimo a celebrareis.

verses.original: בַּסֻּכֹּ֥ת תֵּשְׁב֖וּ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כָּל־ הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַּסֻּכֹּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: bas·suk·kōṯ tê·šə·ḇū šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm kāl- hā·’ez·rāḥ bə·yiś·rā·’êl yê·šə·ḇū bas·suk·kōṯ
verses.literal: You are to dwell in booths for seven days All the native-born of Israel must dwell in booths
verses.literalPt: Sete dias habitareis em tendas; todos os naturais em Israel habitarão em tendas;

verses.original: לְמַעַן֮ יֵדְע֣וּ דֹרֹֽתֵיכֶם֒ כִּ֣י בַסֻּכּ֗וֹת הוֹשַׁ֙בְתִּי֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּהוֹצִיאִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yê·ḏə·‘ū ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem kî ḇas·suk·kō·wṯ hō·wō·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·hō·w·ṣî·’î ’ō·w·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: so that your descendants may know that I made the Israelites . . . dwell in booths when I brought them out of the land of Egypt I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Para que saibam as vossas gerações que eu fiz habitar os filhos de Israel em tendas, quando os tirei da terra do Egito. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־ מֹעֲדֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr mō·šeh ’eṯ- mō·‘ă·ḏê Yah·weh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Moses announced to the Israelites . . . the appointed feasts of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim pronunciou Moisés as solenidades do SENHOR aos filhos de Israel.
